After a power pellet, ghosts are frightened for a few seconds and can be eaten for bonus points. Each option lists facts about the path through that exit: ghost = steps to the nearest normal ghost (null if none within 15), ghost_coming = that ghost is moving toward you, edible = steps to the nearest frightened ghost, pellets = pellets within 6 steps, food = steps to the nearest pellet, power = steps to the nearest power pellet. Steps count from Pac-Man, including the corridor up to the junction. 'back' means turn around right now instead of going to the junction.

State:
{"lives":2,"pellets_left":30,"to_junction":3.9,"options":{"up":{"ghost":null,"pellets":0,"food":12.9},"left":{"ghost":null,"pellets":0,"food":13.9},"back":{"ghost":null,"pellets":0,"food":18.1}}}

Options:
- up
- left
- back: turn around now

Answer with only a JSON object: {"move": "<one of the options>"}<|end|><|assistant|>
grammar:
root ::= "{" space move-kv "}" space
move-kv ::= "\"move\"" space ":" space move
move ::= ("\"up\"" | "\"left\"" | "\"back\"") space
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
